automation.description: Signs in as admin in SmartClient (desktop UX/UI) as a report administrator: designs a report with the wizard, tests it, manages specifications, and checks the Report Schedules list, then deletes the report.

interaction.name: Reports menu: the SmartClient tools, not the Reports list
interaction.description: Checks the Reports menu offers the SmartClient tools (Report Manager, Report Designer, Report Schedules) and not the PrimeFaces Reports list.

interaction.name: Report Designer: design a report with the wizard
interaction.description: Designs a report with the wizard, a constant dataset and a query dataset, checks the wizard refuses to continue until the parameter has a type, then saves the report and finds it in the list.

dataEnter.value: select a from {admin.ReportTemplate} a where a.name = :uname

interaction.name: Report Designer: a report name already in use is refused
interaction.description: Starts a second report with the same name and checks it is refused as already defined.

interaction.name: Datasets: TestQuery runs a query and refuses a class that is not there
interaction.description: Runs Test Query on the query dataset and checks its results, then adds a dataset for a class that does not exist and checks Test Query reports an error.

method.comment: Records current behaviour: TestQuery.java:162 throws a DomainException, so the user sees only the generic error and its reference (the server log has "Unable to create an instance of sail.NoSuchDataset"). If the product is fixed to refuse with a ValidationException, change this assertion to the real message.

testFailure.message: An error occurred while processing your request

interaction.name: Test Report, Download Template and Export Report Specification, and a Test Report refused with unsaved changes
interaction.description: Runs Test Report, Download Template and Export Report Specification on the saved report, then changes it without saving and checks Test Report is refused.

method.comment: Records current behaviour: TestReport.java:45 throws a DomainException, so the user sees only the generic error (the server log has "This report template has unsaved changes. Please save the template then try again."). If the product is fixed to refuse with a ValidationException, change this assertion to that message.

testFailure.message: An error occurred while processing your request

interaction.name: Report Schedules: only enabled reports are listed
interaction.description: Checks Report Schedules lists the report, then disables the report and checks it drops out of the list, and enables it and checks it returns.

interaction.name: Report Manager: export, and import validated and imported
interaction.description: Exports report specifications, refusing it until a report is selected, then imports a specification as a validation only, refuses an invalid file, imports it for real twice, and checks the report appears once and is then deleted.

testFailure.message: Please select at least one report to export
The file was not recognised as a valid report

method.comment: PRODUCT GAP: a file that is neither .json nor .zip (sail/files/sail-invalid.txt) should be refused with "File type ... is not recognised as either json or zip", but ImportReportSpecifications.upload(ImportReportSpecifications.java:160) calls upload.getMimeType().toString() on a null mime type and throws a NullPointerException, so the user sees only the generic error. Not asserted here: see findings.md

method.comment: Importing the same specification again replaces the report of that name

testValue.value: A report specification imported by the SAIL admin suite

interaction.name: Report Designer: delete the report
interaction.description: Deletes the designed report and checks it is gone from the designer and from Report Schedules.
